About Us

American Century Investments® is a leading global asset manager with over 65 years of experience helping a broad base of clients achieve their financial goals. Our expertise spans global equities and fixed income, multi-asset strategies, ETFs, and private investments.

Privately owned and independent, we focus solely on investment management. But there’s an unexpected side to us, too. We direct 40% of our dividends every year—over $2 billion since 2000—to the Stowers Institute for Medical Research. Our ongoing financial support drives the Institute’s breakthrough work and mission of defeating life-threatening diseases like cancer and Alzheimer’s.

So, the better we do for our clients, the more we can do for everyone.

All who work here around the globe are inspired every day by the unique difference our hard work can make in so many lives. It shows in the curiosity we bring to every initiative, the deep relationships we build with our clients, and the way we treat each other in the hallway. If you’re excited to learn more about us, we can’t wait to learn more about you.

Role Summary

As a Risk Analyst
in Global Fixed Income you will support the identification, measurement, monitoring, and reporting of risks across fixed income portfolios. Working closely with portfolio managers, analysts, and senior members of the risk team, you will help evaluate portfolio exposures, conduct risk analysis, and contribute to ongoing risk oversight activities. This role requires a strong analytical mindset, an interest in fixed income markets, and the ability to communicate risk findings effectively.

This role reports to Head of Fixed Income Risk Management.

This hybrid position will be based out of our Santa Clara, CA or our New York City, NY office.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship, now or in the future.

How You Will Make An Impact

Risk Analysis and Monitoring

Support the monitoring of fixed income portfolios to ensure compliance with established risk limits and guidelines.
Analyze portfolio exposures related to credit risk, interest rate risk, liquidity risk, market risk, and other key risk factors.
Assist in identifying emerging risks and escalating findings to senior risk management professionals as appropriate.
Conduct routine and ad hoc risk analyses to assess portfolio risk characteristics and trends.

Risk Assessment and Stress Testing

Perform quantitative analysis and stress testing to evaluate the potential impact of various market scenarios on fixed income portfolios.
Assist in the development and enhancement of portfolio risk metrics and analytical tools.
Support research efforts related to risk measurement methodologies and market developments.

Reporting and Analytics

Prepare regular risk reports and dashboards for portfolio managers, investment teams, and senior management.
Assist in the production and review of performance attribution and risk reporting.
Monitor data quality and ensure the accuracy and timeliness of risk analytics and reporting deliverables.
Work with internal client and investment reporting teams to satisfy data requests.

Collaboration and Investment Support

Partner with portfolio managers, analysts, and traders to provide risk insights supporting investment decision-making.
Contribute to portfolio reviews by identifying key risk exposures and discussing potential implications.
Support model portfolio analytics and risk assessments for prospective and existing clients.

Risk Framework and Process Support

Assist with maintaining risk management policies, procedures, and documentation.
Support enhancements to risk management frameworks, methodologies, and reporting processes.
Participate in projects aimed at improving risk systems, tools, and operational efficiencies.

Regulatory and Compliance Support

Help ensure adherence to internal risk policies and applicable regulatory requirements.
Monitor regulatory developments affecting fixed income investments and assist in evaluating their potential impact on risk management practices.
Support internal and external audits, compliance reviews, and regulatory reporting initiatives as needed.

What You Bring To The Team (Required)

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Risk Management, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in investment risk management, portfolio analytics, fixed income research, or a related financial services role.
Understanding of fixed income markets, instruments, and risk concepts.
Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including proficiency with Excel and risk analytics platforms.
Experience working with large datasets and performing quantitative analysis.
Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present findings clearly.
Detail-oriented with strong organizational and problem-solving abilities.
Demonstrates the American Century Investments Winning Behaviors: Client Focused, Courageous and Accountable, Collaborative, Curious and Adaptable, Competitively Driven.

Additional Assets (Preferred)

Familiarity with risk systems such as Aladdin, Bloomberg PORT, FactSet, Yield Book, or similar platforms.
Knowledge of performance attribution, portfolio analytics, and fixed income risk metrics.
Experience with programming or data analysis tools such as Python, SQL, or VBA is highly preferred.
Progress toward or interest in pursuing a CFA, FRM, or similar professional designation is a plus.

Position Summary

Botrista is seeking a highly analytical and commercially minded Revenue Operations Analyst to help us better understand what drives revenue growth, customer performance, retention, and profitability across the business.

Reporting to the Revenue Operations Manager, this role will serve as a shared analytical resource across Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance. The Revenue Analyst will connect data across Sales, Account Management, customer performance, deployments, operations, and financial results to identify trends, explain performance, uncover opportunities and risks, and support better business decisions.

This is not simply a reporting role. We are looking for someone who is naturally curious, comfortable digging into complex data, and able to move beyond what happened to understand why it happened and what we should do about it.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical skills with commercial judgment and can translate complex analysis into clear, actionable insights for business leaders.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Performance & Business Analysis

Analyze revenue performance against plan and identify the underlying drivers of variances.
Evaluate new customer revenue, recurring ingredient revenue, same-store performance, customer retention, expansion, cups sold daily (CSD), deployments, and other key revenue drivers.
Develop cohort and segmentation analyses across verticals, customer types, sales channels, territories, deal structures, acquisition sources, and other relevant dimensions.
Identify emerging trends, risks, anomalies, and growth opportunities before they become obvious in topline results.
Partner with Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance to develop a consistent view of commercial and financial performance.
Translate analysis into clear recommendations and business actions.

Sales Analytics

Analyze pipeline health, coverage, conversion, sales velocity, win/loss performance, quota attainment, and seller productivity.
Evaluate lead sources, territories, customer segments, ICP performance, and sales motions.
Support analysis of sales capacity, territory design, quotas, and resource allocation.
Measure the downstream quality of customers acquired by Sales, including deployment, utilization, recurring revenue, retention, and expansion.
Support deployment and revenue forecasting and analyze forecast accuracy over time.

Customer Revenue & Retention Analytics

Analyze CSD, ingredient consumption, recurring revenue, account health, attrition, and expansion across the installed base.
Identify leading indicators of customer growth and churn risk.
Develop customer cohorts and account segmentation to identify which characteristics correlate with strong long-term performance.
Analyze Account Management interventions to determine which activities actually improve customer revenue, retention, and expansion.
Help develop data-driven account prioritization and opportunity/risk scoring.
Quantify revenue at risk and potential revenue upside across the existing customer base.

Customer Economics & Revenue Quality

Help develop a holistic view of customer value across the full lifecycle:

Sale → Deployment → Live → Productive → Recurring Revenue → Retention → Expansion

Evaluate customer economics across verticals, deal structures, sales channels, customer profiles, and other meaningful segments.
Partner with Finance to incorporate margin, cost, and profitability considerations into commercial analysis.
Identify customer and program characteristics associated with higher long-term economic value.
Help the organization move beyond measuring success solely by sales or installations toward measuring the quality and durability of revenue created.

Forecasting, Planning & Scenario Modeling

Support commercial revenue and deployment forecasting.
Build and maintain analytical models for revenue growth, customer performance, capacity, retention, and other business drivers.
Partner with Commercial Planning and Finance on operating plans, forecasts, and scenario analysis.
Evaluate the expected impact of changes in headcount, productivity, pricing, customer mix, retention, CSD, deployment timing, and other key assumptions.
Perform sensitivity analyses to help leadership understand the range of potential business outcomes.

Reporting & Business Reviews

Build and maintain core Sales, Account Management, and revenue performance reporting.
Support weekly and monthly business reviews with analysis of key trends, exceptions, risks, and opportunities.
Maintain consistent metric definitions and help establish a trusted source of truth across Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance.
Improve existing reporting by eliminating low-value metrics and introducing measures that better reflect business performance.
Automate recurring analysis and reporting wherever practical.

Strategic & Ad Hoc Analysis

Support leadership with analytical work on high-priority business questions, including:

Which customer segments and verticals generate the greatest long-term value?
What predicts high CSD, recurring revenue, retention, and expansion?
Where are we losing revenue and why?
Which sales motions and acquisition sources produce the highest-quality customers?
Where should we add or reduce Sales and Account Management resources?
Which programs and initiatives are generating measurable incremental value?
Where are operational bottlenecks limiting revenue?
Which parts of the business should we scale, improve, or reconsider?
What are we not currently measuring that could materially change how we operate?

Cross-Functional Operating Model

The Revenue Analyst will be a shared analytical resource across Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance.

The role reports to the Revenue Operations Manager, who will help prioritize the analyst's overall workload and ensure analytical work translates into commercial action. However, the analyst will work directly and regularly with Commercial Planning and Finance and will support important analytical and planning needs across all three functions.

Success requires operating as part of one analytical ecosystem rather than three separate teams. The expectation is to create shared definitions, shared data, and a common understanding of business performance while bringing the appropriate functional perspective to each analysis.

Revenue Performance & Business Analysis

Technical Business Analyst (NYC)

Embrava | New York, NY (Onsite)

Embrava connects digital systems with the physical environments where people spend their time, making information visible and actionable the moment it matters. Through products including Blynclight, Desk Sign, Room Sign, and Any Sign, we support more than 15,000 customers across 32 countries from our offices in the US, UK, and Australia. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a Technical Business Analyst to manage multiple projects across our business and tech teams, bringing a solid grasp of software alongside the people skills to work directly with clients.

We're looking for a Technical Business Analyst to sit at the center of how Embrava builds its internal systems. You’ll work directly with the business teams who use our tools: learning how the business runs, turning that knowledge into clear requirements and user stories, and helping build practical solutions. This role is a great fit for someone early in their career who's curious, quick to pick up a new system, and already uses AI as a natural part of how they work. You don't need to be a professional software developer, but you should understand programming fundamentals, databases, and how software systems fit together and be as comfortable talking with engineers as well as with the people using the product.

Help grow and manage the critical systems and technology platforms that support the company’s internal functions
Collaborate with business teams and clients to understand workflows and pain points, translating business needs into clear requirements, user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria to guide application development.
Map current and future workflows, identify opportunities for automation, and evaluate practical solutions.
Use AI-powered development tools and coding assistants to prototype, build, modify, debug, test, and improve internal business applications
Evaluate data structures, dependencies, business logic, and technical feasibility when defining solutions.
Support testing and user acceptance testing (UAT), then train users and gather feedback to keep iterating the system

What We're Looking For

1-3 years of experience in business analysis, product, business systems, or a related role
Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Management Information Systems, Business Analytics, Human Centered Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
Foundational knowledge of object-oriented programming, software architecture, and how applications and databases interact.
Experience translating business needs into clear functional and technical specifications for software solutions.
Understanding of database structures, including schemas, tables, relationships, primary and foreign keys, and data dependencies.
Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including the ability to evaluate business logic, exceptions, dependencies, and alternative scenarios.
Comfort with change and the ability to adjust to evolving demands and requirements
Demonstrated comfort using AI tools to support analysis, prototyping, development, testing, and problem-solving.
Effective verbal and written communication, with the ability to explain technical ideas clearly to non-technical users
Familiarity with Agile product development and iterative software delivery.
Ability to manage multiple projects at once, keeping business and tech stakeholders updated on progress, risks, and decisions
Ability to model business processes and data structures using workflow diagrams, process maps, or entity-relationship diagrams.

Nice to Have

Master's degree in Information Systems, Business Analytics, Information Management, Computer Engineering, or a related field
Hands-on experience with Python, Java, or other programming languages.
Experience building internal tools, prototypes, automations, or lightweight applications.
Experience with CRM platforms, ETL tools, reporting platforms, or database technologies.
Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, and process-mapping tools.

Total compensation up to $125,000

Your earnings grow with your impact. The starting base salary for this role is $90,000-$110,000, based on your skills, experience, and education. Through annual performance bonuses and pay increases, strong performers can reach up to $125,000 in total compensation. Bonuses are pro-rated in your first year based on when you join.

An entrepreneurial, low-hierarchy environment with visibility to the leadership team and a real voice in how our systems get built

Excellence Community Schools (ECS) is a Charter Management Organization (CMO) supporting schools in the Bronx, NY and Stamford, CT. Our programs are based on a proven, nationally recognized model, which originated in our flagship school, the Bronx Charter School for Excellence, a National Blue Ribbon School.

Our Mission and Vision

Our schools prepare young scholars to compete for admission to and succeed in top public, private, and parochial high schools by cultivating their intellectual, artistic, social, emotional, and ethical development. We accomplish this by offering a challenging and rigorous academic curriculum, which at the earliest of grades has an eye towards college preparation. To achieve this, our schools create a supportive and caring environment that consistently holds high expectations for all students. We offer a differentiated, project-based learning environment that seeks to develop high-level analytical and critical-thinking skills in all our students. Our engaging and rigorous approach to educating our scholars is implemented by a collaborative team of teachers.

Who We Need

We are seeking a Data Analyst
to support reporting, data quality processes, analytical projects, and data-driven decision making across the organization. This role will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure data accuracy, develop actionable insights, and support operational and strategic initiatives through analysis and reporting.

The Data Analyst will also support quantitative analysis and data-informed planning to evaluate program effectiveness, monitor operational performance, and inform strategic decision-making across schools and organizational functions. This may include analyzing trends, assessing outcomes of organizational initiatives, supporting enrollment and operational planning, and supporting academic and operational reporting processes such as report cards and progress monitoring.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with large datasets. This position is well-suited for a professional with strong technical aptitude and an interest in data analytics, reporting, statistical analysis, and operational problem-solving in an education setting.

Reporting & Analytics

Create and maintain recurring reports, dashboards, and visualizations for operational and academic stakeholders.
Support report card, progress monitoring, enrollment, attendance, assessment, and other school-based reporting processes.
Conduct analyses to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that support school and organizational goals.
Present findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Quantitative Analysis & Strategic Support

Support analytical projects using quantitative and statistical methods.
Conduct trend analysis and support forecasting and planning initiatives using historical and operational data.
Analyze program effectiveness and operational outcomes to support continuous improvement efforts.
Identify patterns, risk indicators, and opportunities for operational and academic improvement.

Data Quality & Data Management

Perform data validation, auditing, cleaning, and quality assurance checks across multiple systems and datasets.
Identify, investigate, and resolve data inconsistencies, missing values, and reporting anomalies.
Support efforts to improve data accuracy, consistency, reliability, and documentation practices.
Maintain documentation related to reports, metrics, business rules, and data processes.

Support the maintenance and monitoring of data systems and data warehouse processes.
Assist with data integration, transformation, and validation activities.
Troubleshoot data discrepancies, report issues, and address system-related data concerns.
Collaborate with internal teams to support operational and reporting needs across schools and departments.

Collaboration & Operational Support

Work collaboratively with school-based and central teams to understand reporting and analytical needs.
Support users with dashboards, reports, data interpretation, and troubleshooting.
Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to analytics, reporting, and data governance.

Familiarity with data analysis concepts and statistical methods.
Experience working with spreadsheets and datasets.
